children.name: Intercept
children.remark:
Number of intercept hit connections per second, including the following:
Ready to intercept(total): the number of connections per second when hit security 
policy intercept action；
Ready to intercept(duplicate traffic): the number of connections per second

children.name: Intercept Failed
children.remark:
The number of connections per second that the blade failed to intercept for different 
reasons is as follows:
Asymmetric traffic-asymmetric traffic, unsupported tunnel – unsupported tunnel 
type,
duplicated traffic - duplicated traffic,
no available L7 mod

children.name: Logs
children.remark: Number of logs per second sent by the blade to OLMP

children.name: Throughtput (by Protocol)
children.remark: The traffic volume of the different protocols handled by the blade.

children.name: Overload Protection
children.remark:
The number of connections per second that bypassed by the firewall for DDOS 
protection.

children.name: Policy Hits (Action)
children.remark: Number of connections for each action of the blade no hit/hit security policy

children.name: Connections/s (by Direction)
children.remark:
The number of connections/second of asymmetric/symmetric traffic in different 
directions handled by blade

children.name: Connections (Concurrent)
children.remark: The number of concurrent connections at the current moment in the blade

children.name: SSL Stream (Error)
children.remark: SSL errors per second for proxy and upstream

children.name: Connections/s (Bypass/Intercept)
children.remark: Bypass success/ intercept success connections per second

children.name: Dynamic Bypass (Reason)
children.remark:
The current chart is used to calculate the traffic 
characteristics of SSL in proxy，with these 
characteristics traffic could be 
dynamic bypass (need to configure the decryption 
profile)

children.name: Connections (SSL/Plain)
children.remark: New HTTPS/HTTP created per second

children.name: Keyring Cache Num
children.remark: Average number of faked server certificates cached by ADC devices

children.name: Keyring Cache Hit Ratio
children.remark: The hit ratio of a faked server certificate cached by proxy device

children.name: Proxy Policy Hit (Action)
children.remark: Logs hit when there are different actions in proxy policies

children.name: Handshake Event
children.remark: Abnormal of proxy SSL handshake at various stages

children.name: Connections (Concurrent)
children.remark: Number of concurrent connections per second

children.name: Handshake Latency
children.remark: Proxy SSL handshake latency (including upstream SSL handshake + downstream SSL handshake)

children.name: Connections/s (Open/Close)
children.remark: Number of concurrent connections per second

children.name: Memory
children.remark: Calculate memory usage of the blade

children.name: Disk
children.remark: Calculate disk usage of the blade

children.name: CPU
children.remark: Calculate CPU usage of the blade

children.name: PSI
children.remark: Pressure Stall Information (PSI)

children.name: Temperature
children.remark: Calculate temperature of the blade
